(where उ˚ means also ‘gone astray, ill-behaved’). .²3 Grown, increased. .²4 Exalted, prosperous. .²5 Proud, furious, haughty; परिधत्त किमुद्वृत्ता राजद्रव्याण्यभीप्सथ <ls>Bhāg. 10. 41. 35</ls>. ˚मृगपति <ls>K. 90</ls>. .²6 Vomited up. .²7 Left as a remainder. .²8 Ill-conducted, ill-mannered, rude. .²9 Agitated; उद्वृत्तनक्रात् सहसोन्ममज्ज <ls>R. 16. 79</ls>. .²10 Turned up, opened wide (as eyes). .{@-त्तः@} A particular position of the hands in dancing. .{@-त्तम्@} (in astronomy) The east and west hour circle or six oʼclock line.
